Messages.Author: DJ.Mik
Messages.Body:
Hi there !

Well, I was just sitting considering a deck idea last night and would
like if someone could answer this simple question:

If I play Ashes to Ashes is it possible for me to play an Undead
Persistence immediately afterwards to avoid the effect of A.t.A., and
if yes what happens?

a) my vampire untaps and gains two blood, but remains ready until
combat ends

OR

b) the entire effect of A.t.A. is sustained until combat ends

Thanx !
DJ Mik

By the way, is it possible to sustain the effect of Rötschreck with an
Undead Persistence ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DJ.Mik wrote:
> If I play Ashes to Ashes is it possible for me to play an Undead
> Persistence immediately afterwards to avoid the effect of A.t.A., and
> if yes what happens?

Yes.

> a) my vampire untaps and gains two blood, but remains ready until
> combat ends

This.

> By the way, is it possible to sustain the effect of Rötschreck with an
> Undead Persistence ?

No. R. ends combat first, then sends the victim to torpor.
